title: Tunable consistency: quorum, one and all

videos.script: Lesson 1 made a promise about Cassandra. {{promise}} The same table would refuse when copies cannot agree, and answer anyway when told to. This lesson keeps it. First, three copies of every partition. {{rf}} One line raises the replication factor, and Cassandra warns that the old rows were not copied. Then a monitor with one unit left. {{stop}} You stop one node. QUORUM still reads and writes. ALL is refused at once, with the real error. You stop a second node. {{two}} Now QUORUM is refused too, and ONE still answers. Same table, same row. The level decided. Next, the arithmetic. {{sum}} If the replicas a read asks and the replicas a write waited for must overlap, the read sees the write. R plus W greater than the replication factor. And for two regions, LOCAL_QUORUM. {{dc}} Last, two customers buying the same monitor. {{race}} QUORUM cannot stop that race. A conditional write can. It is refused for the second customer, and a trace shows its price: four round trips instead of one. {{paxos}}
